title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.31: The compendium now actually shows the gold character shadow on the Understudy's relics and potions. They were drawn as unseen 'unknown' tiles, which never get the color; now they're marked seen (like base-game character content). Book of Endings stays hidden until obtained.
